notes.title: Quality of More Update
notes.content:
Features include:



20+ New Anomalies, including 6 new entities.

A fully custom FPS limiter, no more GPU explosions.

Many bugfixes, including Haunts not having anomalies assigned right, anomalies being assigned to the wrong report type, and some anomalies just not appearing at all.



Both maps have received new content and new entities, Have fun finding them all!
